notes.title: Update to 4.13.4
notes.content:
The game has been updated to the latest available patch version 4.13.4.

If you prefer the older version 4.12.2 for some reason, you can revert to it (go to the Betas tab in the Steam properties of the game and select version 4_12_2 in the drop-down list).

notes.title: IL-2 Sturmovik 1946 Updated
notes.content: IL-2 Sturmovik 1946, the complete collection of many addons released for the legendary sim, has been updated. Russian-speaking players can now play the game in its original language while everybody would benefit from Steam Cloud addition (profile data such as player controls and campaign progress are now backed up online).
